name: Quality Woodworking and Store Fixtures LLC
old_description: Quality Woodworking and Store Fixtures is owned and operated by Frank Carrion, who has over 35 years of experience in Architectural Woodworking, Architectural Metalwork, Cabinetry, Millwork, Trade Show Exhibits and Store Fixtures. Frank and his team take their time with each project and work solely to achieve each client’s complete satisfaction.  No project is too big or too small for Frank to take on.   Not only does he have the experience, but he has the eye for this industry.  His attention to detail is stellar and his own expectations exceed what is being asked of him.  He initially founded MCA Woodworkers, Inc., a successful Long Island based company in 2004.  When new opportunity arose, he moved to Virginia to work as Director of Production for Premier Store Fixtures.  He was extremely successful in this position for five years but he yearned to open his own company again.
about:
Quality Woodworking and Store Fixtures was founded in 2018 by Frank Carrion in Ashland, Virginia. Carrion, who brings over 35 years of experience in architectural woodworking, metalwork, cabinetry, and millwork, previously founded MCA Woodworkers Inc. on Long Island in 2004. After serving five years as director of production for Premier Store Fixtures, he returned to business ownership to establish the current shop. The company operates as a sole proprietorship under Carrion’s leadership.

The shop specializes in custom architectural woodwork and millwork, including cabinetry, kitchens, residential furniture, store fixtures, and architectural metalwork. It also produces trade show exhibits. All work is performed on a project basis, with no stated facility size, headcount, or annual volume disclosed.

The company serves clients in retail, residential construction, trade show marketing, and general architectural millwork. Concrete examples from its service list include custom store fixtures for retail environments, cabinetry and furniture for residential projects, and exhibit fabrication for trade shows.

Carrion started the business to apply his exacting standards and “old-fashioned values” to every project, regardless of size. The firm emphasizes that “can’t is not in our vocabulary” and pledges to exceed client expectations through attention to detail and a willingness to tackle any scope.
